frame_wall_definition: FrameExecutionStart.started_at to post-Host observation.now; App plus native Host/submit wall including waits, not CPU execution/GPU execution/scanout
gpu_completion_definition: original App frame start to queue-completion callback observation, not GPU execution/scanout

process_cost.memory_scope: whole-process point samples, not per-UI retained bytes or leak proof; sequential runs share loaded code and driver allocations
process_cost.scope: whole-process CPU between first and last measured post-Host callbacks; includes observer/poll/background/driver CPU, excludes startup/warmup; not GPU execution

startup.missing_phase_definition: null optional_ns means the phase was not reached or observed; zero is a measured completed duration
startup.observation_point: completed original snapshot copied after neutral keyboard inventory, paused maintenance and canonical capture; earlier completed phases are unchanged from initial initialized paused settle; before reveal, input activation, Resume and running-frame warmup
startup.outcome_authority: diagnostic snapshot only; original progress, complete paused capture, presentation and physical retirement APIs remain authoritative

phases.scope: original source check, plan creation and begin-start admission
complete original Runtime startup attempt before native transfer
initial Pause request, presentation driver and original WinitSession construction
first nonblocking native poll, including window, device and render work it performs
sum of original native poll calls through first actual presentation, including the remainder of that poll and excluding caller gaps; overlaps FirstNativePoll

public_call_boundaries.scope: initial settle includes original cooperative poll/capture/maintenance until initialized paused state; the separate neutral interval includes restore_keyboard_holds and paused maintenance, excluding later canonical capture; public spans overlap the internal phases and must not be summed with them
